title: Run the remaining real-Git target and helper policy cases on macOS and Linux, and isolate the Unix real-Git status test from the host checkout and config
outcome: Run the remaining real-Git target and helper policy cases on macOS and Linux, and isolate the Unix real-Git status test from the host checkout and config
acceptance: The Windows-only real-Git policy cases run on macOS and Linux too, through one shared module as the service tests already do: all malformed URLs, the fabricated URL key-split check, the assert_config checks for credential.helper, http.sslVerify and http.followRedirects, the shell-helper-before-manager order, and the no-write snapshots
The Unix real-Git status test runs in its own initialised repository with isolated Git configuration, so the enclosing checkout and the host's global and system config cannot change its result
Those tests pass on macOS, Linux and Windows

completion.summary:
The Windows-only real-Git target and helper policy cases now run on macOS and Linux too. They live in one shared module, tests/policy_cases.rs, which both the Unix and Windows drivers call: all 14 malformed URLs, the fabricated key-split, the three assert_config checks, the shell-helper-before-manager refusal, and the no-write snapshots. The Unix real-Git status test runs in its own initialised repository with isolated Git config: an empty global config, its own HOME and XDG paths, system config disabled, and inherited GIT_* overrides removed. All of this ships in w-6bba candidate 2839f80e258035f0381979ab8b96edfe4a67e9f9 (tree 102fe67e). Test evidence on that commit:
- macOS: test-bd75114f, 31 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored.
- Linux: test-1bf44e90, 31/0/2, and FULL test-f82e7072.
- Windows: exclusive credited run test-36f61dce, 56/0. An earlier contended failure (test-5f2735f7) was classified as host contention; robustness item w-ab273bb530b4 tracks it.
The second independent evaluation (delegation c04b6c0a) passed 3/3. Not yet landed; the Merger lands the w-6bba package.
